{{Quote|My men downed the vessel a few days ago. It crashed somewhere nearby, buried under a mountain of snow. I asked for someone to investigate the wreckage when the snow thawed, and those twits volunteered. Like an idiot, I allowed it.|Lanoyo|<ref name="Mission" />}}
'''Lanoyo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] who was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. When his men downed an [[House of Organa/Legends|Organa]] transport in the northern [[Kaamos Territory]], he eventually allowed [[House of Thul|House Thul]] forces to investigate the wreckage&mdash;but was furious when they died in the process, and thus recruited Imperial forces to investigate.
